info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Mortgage Loans Status API provides access to the current status of mortgage loans within a specified system. Users can query this endpoint to obtain real-time updates on loan processing stages, facilitating effective tracking and management of mortgage portfolios. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, loan officers, and service providers who need to monitor the status of loans to ensure timely action and improve customer communication. It enables integration into applications that require loan status information for reporting or operational purposes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of loans in the system. You can check the status to understand whether loans are approved, pending, or rejected.

requestBody.description: This request body allows clients to specify the criteria for fetching the status of loans. It should conform to the specified schema and include the necessary parameters to retrieve the relevant loan status information.

202.description: The request has been accepted and is being processed.

ListMortgageLoansStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for retrieving the status of loans operations via GET.
